quiz.q.w1: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many stars can one war attack be worth at most?
quiz.q.w1.why: An attack is worth 3 stars at most: one for 50% destruction, one for the Town Hall, one for 100%.
quiz.q.w2: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many attacks does each member get in a regular war?
quiz.q.w2.why: In a regular war each member in the roster gets 2 attacks.
quiz.q.w3: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how long does the preparation day last?
quiz.q.w3.why: The preparation day lasts 23 hours, then the 24 hours of battle begin.
quiz.q.w4: 🧠 Quiz of the week: with the same number of stars, who wins the war?
quiz.q.w4.why: With the same stars, the clan with the higher destruction percentage wins.
quiz.q.w5: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many clans are there in a CWL group?
quiz.q.w5.why: A CWL group has 8 clans and lasts 7 days.
quiz.q.w6: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many attacks does each member get on a CWL day?
quiz.q.w6.why: In CWL each member in the roster gets only 1 attack per day.
quiz.q.c1: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many base attacks does everyone get on a raid weekend?
quiz.q.c1.why: On a raid weekend everyone gets 5 base attacks.
quiz.q.c2: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many bonus attacks can you earn on a raid weekend?
quiz.q.c2.why: Finishing a district earns 1 bonus attack, only one each.
quiz.q.c3: 🧠 Quiz of the week: which day does the raid weekend start?
quiz.q.c3.why: The raid weekend starts on Friday and ends on Monday.
quiz.q.c4: 🧠 Quiz of the week: what do you earn by finishing a raid weekend?
quiz.q.c4.why: Finishing the raids earns Raid Medals, to spend in the clan shop.
quiz.q.c5: 🧠 Quiz of the week: can Capital Gold be donated to clanmates?
quiz.q.c5.3: No, it only serves the Capital
quiz.q.c5.why: Capital Gold can't be donated: it only serves the Clan Capital.
quiz.q.c6: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many times a week is there a raid weekend?
quiz.q.c6.why: There is one raid weekend per week.
quiz.q.a1: 🧠 Quiz of the week: which troop goes straight for the walls?
quiz.q.a1.why: Wall Breakers run straight at the walls and open them for the ground troops.
quiz.q.a2: 🧠 Quiz of the week: at which Town Hall does the Barbarian King unlock?
quiz.q.a2.why: The Barbarian King unlocks at Town Hall 7.
quiz.q.a3: 🧠 Quiz of the week: at which Town Hall does the Archer Queen unlock?
quiz.q.a3.why: The Archer Queen unlocks at Town Hall 9.
quiz.q.a4: 🧠 Quiz of the week: at which Town Hall does the Grand Warden unlock?
quiz.q.a4.why: The Grand Warden unlocks at Town Hall 11.
quiz.q.a5: 🧠 Quiz of the week: at which Town Hall does the Royal Champion unlock?
quiz.q.a5.why: The Royal Champion unlocks at Town Hall 13.
quiz.q.a6: 🧠 Quiz of the week: which defence hits air troops only?
quiz.q.a6.why: The Air Defense only hits air troops.
quiz.q.n1: 🧠 Quiz of the week: what is the maximum number of members in a clan?
quiz.q.n1.why: A clan can have at most 50 members.
quiz.q.n2: 🧠 Quiz of the week: which is the highest role in a clan?
quiz.q.n2.why: The Leader is the highest role in the clan, above the co-leaders.
quiz.q.n3: 🧠 Quiz of the week: which day of the month do Clan Games start?
quiz.q.n3.why: Clan Games start on the 22nd of every month.
quiz.q.n4: 🧠 Quiz of the week: how many days do Clan Games last?

quiz.q.n5.why: The league season ends on the last Monday of the month.

privacy.forget.title: ลบข้อมูลของคุณ
privacy.forget.body:
ผมลบการเชื่อมบัญชี แจ้งเตือนส่วนตัว กิจกรรมของคุณ ซีซันที่กำลังเดินอยู่ ฉายาในชื่อคุณในแคลนที่ผมมีแท็กของคุณ โน้ตของหัวหน้า และข้อความที่รอคิวอยู่

สงครามที่เก็บเข้าคลังแล้วยังอยู่ เป็นข้อมูลเกมที่ผูกกับแท็กและจะไหลออกไปหลังผ่าน 100 สงคราม แถวของแคลนนั้น API ของ Clash ใส่กลับเข้ามาทุกรอบตราบใดที่คุณยังอยู่ในแคลน เพราะอย่างนั้นผมจึงเอาคุณออกจากอันดับสาธารณะด้วยและปล่อยให้อยู่ข้างนอก ฉายาที่ได้จากแคลนที่คุณออกมาแล้วก็ยังอยู่ ในหอเกียรติยศมีแค่ชื่อผู้ชนะ และถ้าไม่มีแท็กของคุณอยู่ตรงนั้น ผมแยกคุณออกจากคนชื่อเดียวกันไม่ได้

web.privacy.title: Privacy
web.privacy.intro: In plain words and without lawyer language: this is everything ClanBoard knows about you, where it keeps it and for how long.
web.privacy.collect.title: What we collect
web.privacy.collect.body: The public game data read from the official Clash of Clans API: clan, roster, wars. The Telegram id and the name of whoever links a village or manages a clan. The clan settings and the texts written by the managers. The day the terms were accepted. Nothing else: no contacts, no location, no phone number.
web.privacy.where.title: Where it lives
web.privacy.where.body: On a single server in Europe. The database is encrypted row by row; the backups are encrypted with the same key and only the last three are kept, the others delete themselves at every nightly backup.
web.privacy.keep.title: How long it stays
web.privacy.keep.body: The history keeps the last {wars} wars per clan, and the same cap holds for the manager log, the former members and the CWL seasons. A clan that stops showing up is deleted after {days} days. News and temporary notes have an expiry and go away on their own.
web.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
web.privacy.rights.body: From the app, «My data» hands you everything about you and «Forget me» deletes it: link, news, seat, warnings and notes. The clan leader can remove the bot from the group and close everything.
web.privacy.never.title: What we never do
web.privacy.never.body: We sell nothing and hand nothing over to anyone. No tracking, no profiling cookies, no ads, no third party beyond Telegram, the Clash of Clans API and Cloudflare carrying the pages.
web.privacy.contact.title: If something looks wrong
web.privacy.contact.body: Tell us before anything else: the rules for reporting are here.
web.privacy.license: The code is free, AGPL-3.0 licence: read it, check it, run it yourself.
web.terms.title: Terms
web.terms.intro: ClanBoard is free and open. Using it means accepting these few lines.
web.terms.who.title: Who can use it
web.terms.who.body: You need a Telegram account, with the minimum age Telegram asks for, and to manage a clan a village linked with the game token. One bot per clan, one clan per group.
web.terms.rules.title: What you must not do
web.terms.rules.body: No spam, scams, harassment or illegal content in the texts the bot publishes; no attempts to get around the limits or to enter where you should not; no use of the game data outside the Supercell terms.
web.terms.service.title: The service as it is
web.terms.service.body: It is free and without warranty: it can stop, get a count wrong or skip a round, and the game data is worth what the official API is worth. There is nothing to pay and nothing to unlock.
web.terms.stop.title: When it stops
web.terms.stop.body: A bot used for harassment or scams is suspended and the clan can be removed. On the other side, the clan leader stops whenever they want: remove the bot from the group and that is the end of it.
web.terms.license: The code is under the AGPL-3.0 licence: you can read it, change it and run it yourself, under the same conditions.

otp.title: SECURITY
otp.on: The Authenticator code is on: the actions that write ask for it every {n} minutes.
otp.off: No code linked yet. «Turn on code» links it to the Authenticator.
otp.hint: 🔐 The Authenticator code is off: turn it on from «Security».
otp.new: Add this key by hand in the Authenticator: {seed} Or paste this address: {uri} The key is shown only now. Then send me a code to try it here.
otp.ask: Send me the six digit code from the Authenticator, then do the action again.
otp.needed: Turn on the Authenticator code first: the actions that write ask for it.
otp.bad: Wrong code, or one already used. Check the Authenticator and try again.
otp.ok: Right code: I will not ask again for {n} minutes. Do the action again.
otp.ready: Code on. From now on the actions that write ask for it every {n} minutes.
otp.seed_left: I could not cover or remove the message with the key: delete it from the chat by hand.
